text: The melody haunted every character's story, a lingering reminder of the lullaby that once brought them peace. It appeared in the most unexpected places—a whistler in the street, a distant radio, the chime of a bell. The motif of the melody tied their stories together, underscoring the shared experiences that knit the fabric of the community. Like the heart, the organ that pumps blood, the tune beat with a rhythmic persistence, circulating through the veins of the neighborhood, ensuring that no one was ever truly alone in their silence.
